domain_restrictions: f is defined for all real numbers

the expression (m : ℝ) means m is viewed as a real number, so x + (m : ℝ) is a real number input to f
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: Assume f satisfies f(x + 1) equals f(x) for all real x. Then for all real x and all natural m (coerced to a real number), f(x + m) equals f(x).
quantifier_order: therefore for every real number x and for every natural number m

variables.role: integer shift amount in the conclusion

variables.name: f
variables.role: maps real inputs to values in a codomain where equality is defined

statement_nl: If for every real number x one has f(x + 1) = f(x), then for every real number x and every natural number m, f(x + (m : ℝ)) = f(x).
